title: Design System: Football Competition Results & Standings Manager

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Short visual feedback for links and buttons only.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single commercial action on a section.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-block; padding: 14px 20px; border-radius: 6px; background: #1F604A; color: #FFFFFF; font: 700 16px Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #174A38; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #A24A10; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Buyer Notice
components.description: A factual eligibility or ownership message.
components.html:
Personal Gmail account required

Work, school and organisation-managed accounts are not currently supported.
components.css: .ds-notice { padding: 18px; border: 1px solid #BFD6C6; border-radius: 12px; background: #E7F0EA; color: #102235; font: 400 16px Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-notice strong { display: block; font-weight: 700; } .ds-notice p { margin: 6px 0 0; }

keyCharacteristics: One primary action at a time.
dos: State delivery and account eligibility plainly.
donts: Do not use generic sports SaaS decoration.
Do not use repeated card grids or side stripes.
